title: UAE Pro League (ADNOC Football)
subtitle: 16-Camera 4K Live OB Truck & Dual EVS Super Slow-Mo
venue: Zayed Sports City & Hazza Bin Zayed Stadiums
role: OB System Engineer, CCU Operator & EVS Replay Lead
summary: Full end-to-end technical engineering for tier-1 live professional football matches, overseeing 16-camera setups, high-frame-rate super slow-mo, VAR integration, and dynamic floodlight camera matching.

specs.replay: 2x EVS XT3 Max (12 Channels Total) + LSM Remote Panels
specs.audioIntercom: Studer Vista 5 Digital Console + Trilogy Intercom Matrix

technicalApproach: Rigged and verified 16 camera positions including High-Center, 18-Yard boxes, Reverse Pitch, Steadicam RF, and Super Slow-Mo goal lines.
Calibrated CCU iris and color temperature across shifting natural sunset to stadium halogen/LED floodlights in real-time.
Configured multi-angle EVS clip playlists for instant referee VAR video review and rapid halftime highlight reels.

signalFlow.description: Tactile fiber triax runs across gantry, pitch-level, and reverse towers
Real-time master black and knee tracking on Sony RCP-1500 panels
Synchronized multi-angle recording on dual EVS XT3 Max with LSM controllers
Dedicated zero-latency multi-split feed sent directly to VAR referee booth
Clean and dirty PGM feeds routed to satellite uplink SNG trucks

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: A primary high-speed fiber connection to Camera 3 (Main Reverse) was severed by a stadium grounds vehicle 35 minutes before kickoff.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Rapidly switched to pre-laid dark fiber backup core and deployed a tactical SMPTE optical conversion jumper within 12 minutes.
challengesAndSolutions.impact: Camera 3 was fully tested, color-matched, and on-air 20 minutes before broadcast countdown.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Sudden heavy arena floodlight flicker caused rolling banding artifacts on 6x high-speed super slow-mo channels.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Adjusted electronic shutter angle phase lock on Sony HDC-4300 CCUs to match the 50Hz LED PWM driver cycle.
challengesAndSolutions.impact: Crystal-clear, flicker-free ultra slow-motion replays throughout the match.

outcomes: Consistently achieved broadcast perfection ratings from Abu Dhabi Sports technical audit board.
Zero missed goals, fouls, or pivotal VAR referee replay demands across entire championship seasons.
improvementReflection: Transitioning all stadium return video monitors to ultra-low-latency NDI/IP feeds helped directors cue replays 1.2 seconds faster.
